publications.label: lead
publications.support: Mnemo completed a main-network release and published its site. Its design includes approved encrypted notes, provider choice, export, and explicit limits on forgetting and provider privacy.

publications.label: new:pixelcommons
publications.support: Completed practice-network release: 64 by 64 squares, sixteen colours, one paint per account every thirty seconds; read-only viewing without an account.

publications.label: new:waggle
publications.support: Named site for a 2,000-seat honeycomb, seat selection and thirty-second refreshes from public network records.

publications.label: new:apex
publications.support: Completed browser three-dimensional racing game; named site. Opening screen inspected read-only: canyon setting, three laps, three pace choices and on-screen steer/brake/boost instructions.

publications.label: bug:permission
publications.support: Report finding 1, Critical: the assistant could issue itself standing spending permission using its own assertion of human intent. Reproduced against a fake payment backend; no live loss established.

publications.label: bug:pinball
publications.support: Report finding 1, Critical: ball rescue reset on relaunch, allowing repeated high-scoring launches without flippers. Local replay tests; no claim of cheating observed in live matches.

publications.label: bug:nightshift
publications.support: Report finding 1, High: account-key file rewritten in place without a backup; an interruption can truncate it. Reported failure path, not an observed real-world loss.

publications.label: watch
publications.support: Completed Quorum release. One active seat one vote, explicit work-responsibility acceptance, and founder control until a separately approved handover. Completion alone is not evidence of that handover or a collective result.

scope: Selected API records establish dates, recorded completion, project scope and reported findings. Read-only opening screens for Mnemo and Apex Run were also inspected; no connected-account action or independent security audit was performed. No claim of adoption or completed Quorum handover is made.
excluded: Copycat projects, offensive material, repetitive promotional sites, price-oriented research and questions attempting to elicit machine configuration were excluded from editorial selection. Aggregate figures include all qualifying records.
